sub_limits_waiting_notes: 90-day initial waiting period for any CI. Pre-existing CI covered only after 4 years (48 months) continuous coverage, with sub-limit: Rs 1L for dependent children; Sum Insured or Rs 10L (whichever is lower) for others. Plan A covers 11 CI; Plan B covers 37 CI. Each family member must opt for same Plan.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Benefit policy — lump sum on diagnosis of CI, not indemnity

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Plan A: 11 listed CIs. Plan B: 37 listed CIs. Lump sum equal to Sum Insured paid on diagnosis (subject to survival period).
critical_illness_cover.notes: Includes Cancer, Heart Attack, CABG, Heart Valve, Coma, Kidney Failure, Stroke, Major Organ Transplant, Permanent Paralysis, Motor Neurone, Multiple Sclerosis (Plan A); plus 26 more in Plan B.

permanent_exclusions: Massages / Spa / Steam Bath / Naturopathy / Experimental
temporary_exclusions: 90 days initial waiting for any CI
Pre-existing CI: 48 months waiting period; sub-limit Rs 1L (kids) / lower of SI or Rs 10L (others)
notable_exclusions_summary: Lump-sum CI benefit policy (not indemnity). Pays on diagnosis after survival period of listed Critical Illness. 90-day initial waiting; PED CI covered only after 4 years with sub-limit. Maternity, AIDS, infertility, war excluded.
claim_process_summary: Notify within 15 days of diagnosis/procedure. Survival period (per CI) must be satisfied. Claim settled within 15 days of last document (45 if investigation needed). Helpline 1800 345 0330.
